audit.whatIsWrong: report[14].t quotes 52%; the packet says 50.00% over 172 games.

audit.why: Lillia owns 1-2, even 3 through 6, Yi takes first item and 2+. Chart matches the packet and both layers agree row for row.
audit.corrected: No change to the level chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: Lilting Lullaby is called 'a long cooldown' with no figure, and treated as an unconditional sleep.
audit.why: It is 150/130/110s, and Riot's text is explicit that it only affects enemies who already have Dream Dust on them. A Yi who has taken no spell damage cannot be slept at all — that is the single most important fact in the matchup and it appeared nowhere on the page.
audit.corrected: The 150s and the Dream Dust precondition written into breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t, content.mid and wants.foe[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: The page attributes Lillia's kiting move speed to Watch Out! Eep! (W) in four places and gives W a knockback in two more. W is a stationary area hit with a heavy centre — no displacement, no movement effect. The move speed is the Blooming Blows (Q) passive, and the only thing that actually breaks your chase is the Swirlseed (E) slow, which Highlander's slow immunity ignores outright.
audit.why: Advice built on a phantom knockback tells you to respect a disengage she does not have, and pointing Highlander's slow immunity at 'her W-driven kite' aims a real counter at the wrong ability.
audit.corrected: phases[1].why, phases[3].why, report[5].t, content.late and spikes[3].text rewritten around Blooming Blows for speed and Swirlseed for the slow. Meditate-cancel by the sleep added to report[5].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: The kit file flags Swirlseed as creating terrain; Riot's description says only that it rolls until it hits a wall or a target.
audit.why: Flagging this as a derived-flag misfire rather than asserting it. I did not write any terrain claim into the page, and I removed the existing 'knockback into terrain' line rather than keeping it.
audit.corrected: No terrain claim written. Recorded for the flag-quality pass.

edits.before: She zones you off the wave with W swings and her DOT stacks faster than your auto cadence, and you still have no Wuju true damage online to punish.
edits.after: She zones you with Watch Out! Eep! on 14s and her Dream Dust stacks faster than your auto cadence, while you have no Wuju true damage online to punish it.

edits.before: Even trades — your Wuju true damage and Meditate heal answer her DOT, but she just disengages with W's movement speed when you commit.
edits.after: Even trades — Wuju true damage and the Meditate heal answer her DOT, but Blooming Blows stacks her move speed and she walks out of your commit.

edits.before: Track her R Lullaby above all — it's a long cooldown and a sleep that turns your all-in into a free kill on you; secondarily watch her W (Watch Out! Eep!) cooldown, the swing that gives her the burst and the movement speed to kite your commit.
edits.after: Track Lilting Lullaby (R) above all — 150s at rank 1, and it only sleeps targets already carrying her Dream Dust, so a clean health bar cannot be slept at all. Then watch Blooming Blows (Q) on 6s, which is the real source of her kiting speed.

edits.before: Alpha Strike's untargetable window phases through Lullaby's sleep and Swirlseed's projectile; Meditate out-heals her Dream Dust DOT; Wuju Style's true damage ignores any defensive AP stat she builds; Highlander's slow immunity answers her W-driven kite.
edits.after: Lilting Lullaby only sleeps a target already carrying her Dream Dust, so refusing her spells beats it. Meditate out-heals the Dream Dust tick, but her sleep cancels the channel; Highlander's slow immunity answers Swirlseed, and her kiting speed is Blooming Blows, not W.

edits.before: EVEN (52% Yi) — a scaling coinflip where you concede a pokey early to her kite and DOT, then out-DPS and out-reset her once your on-hit items come online.
edits.after: EVEN (50% Yi) — a scaling coinflip where you concede a pokey early to her kite and DOT, then out-DPS and out-reset her once your on-hit items come online.

edits.before: The mid-lane phase is a skill check: if you respect her Lilting Lullaby (R) sleep timing and only commit when it's down, Alpha Strike (Q) plus E true damage out-trades her, but eat the sleep-into-Watch Out! (W) combo and you get bursted.
edits.after: The mid phase is a skill check: Lilting Lullaby (R) only sleeps you if her Dream Dust is already ticking, so shed her poke before you commit — Alpha Strike (Q) plus E true damage out-trades her, but eat sleep into Watch Out! (W) and you get bursted.

edits.before: You take over with items — attack speed lets you glue to her past the Blooming Blows (Q) speed, Highlander (R) resets chase through her kiting, and her only real out is a well-placed Watch Out! (W) knockback into terrain.
edits.after: You take over with items — attack speed glues you to her past the Blooming Blows (Q) speed, and Highlander (R) grants slow immunity that ignores the Swirlseed (E) slow, which is her only real way to break off the chase.

edits.before: You out-scale hard: Highlander (R) resets let you dive through her Blooming Blows (Q) speed, and her only escape is Watch Out! (W) knockback and terrain — stay on her and she dies.
edits.after: You out-scale hard: Highlander (R) resets let you dive through her Blooming Blows (Q) speed, and her only escape is stacked speed plus a Swirlseed (E) slow — stay on her and she dies.

edits.before: To land Lilting Lullaby (R) sleep and burst you out of the drowsy
edits.after: To stack Dream Dust on you so Lilting Lullaby (R) can sleep you

notes: The decisive interaction was missing entirely: Lilting Lullaby only affects enemies who already carry Dream Dust, so a Yi who has dodged her spells cannot be slept. Also removed a fabricated Watch Out! Eep! knockback (it is a stationary area hit) and moved the kiting move speed to its real owner, Blooming Blows. Win rate corrected from 52% to the packet's 50%.
